data.one_liner: Provides Dart/Flutter bindings to call native Java code via JNI.
data.what_it_does: Exposes the JNI environment and JavaVM to Dart, allowing creation of Java objects and calling methods. Includes utilities for spawning a JVM on desktop and common Java collection wrappers.
use_when: You need to call existing Java libraries from Flutter on Android or desktop.
You are generating type‑safe bindings with JNIgen and need runtime support.
avoid_when: You only need simple platform channels; a full JNI bridge is overkill.
You target iOS or web where JNI is unavailable.
strengths: Low‑level access to Java without writing platform channel code
Works on Android, Windows, and Linux
Integrates with JNIgen for automated binding generation
weaknesses: Requires native build setup and familiarity with JNI
Limited to platforms that support JVM (no iOS/web)
Potential for memory‑management bugs if misused
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin, ensure C/C++ toolchain is installed, configure Android NDK and desktop build scripts; no extra permissions needed beyond normal Android setup.
